column1: # Game profile of BALL x PIT (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.308 = v524288, one DLC). Plays on Android (Retroid Pocket Nova)
# Unity 6000.0.62f1 (IL2CPP) with FMOD, SDK 20.5.19; subsdk0 is the movie module. The game presents at interval 1 (60 fps). Its control data lists Korean.
# main links Nintendo's online platform libraries (NPLN with gRPC, WebRTC and OpenSSL): nothing of them was seen to matter offline
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: Unity 6 takes all its memory through AllocateAddressRegion. The 5 GB block of the
# other Unity 6 games (4.375 GB alias region); the sdk build gets the node-area cut (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py). In 8 minutes of play the regions' high-water mark reached +2.51 GB
